export_camera_videos: run the script to export an MP4 video for each subdirectory of JPEG frames
export_videos_with_custom_fps: run the script with a custom framerate to export camera videos from image directories
export_videos_from_default_dir: run the script to export videos from the default images-jpeg-2k directory at 12 fps
create_mp4_from_jpg_frames: run the script to create AVC1-encoded MP4 videos from sorted JPEG frames in each subdirectory
review_export_camera_videos: review the script that uses OpenCV and tqdm to batch-export camera image sequences as MP4 videos
